units: mm, g; geometry z up (motor stack on +z), flight report z down; Astra axes x forward, y right

sources.design: v3: tapered closed hollow-box arms (candidate A, criterion X), approved by Krish; engineering choices, not measurements

arm_r.comment: Computed from the supplied main_frame.stl: motor-hole centres are at (Â±56.5, Â±56.5), giving diagonal radius 79.9031 mm. In stock coordinates these are x/y; Astra retains x-forward/y-right.

motor_side.comment: Computed from the supplied main_frame.stl motor-pad centres (Â±56.5, Â±56.5): adjacent centre spacing is 113.0 mm.

frame_t.comment: Supplied main_frame.stl shows 3.0 mm base/pad layer at motor seats; 9.0 mm is overall frame bounding height, not motor-pad thickness.

motor_pad_d.comment: Supplied main_frame.stl motor mounting pad is Ã˜20.0 mm.

motor_hole_spacing.comment: Supplied main_frame.stl and prop_guard(x4).stl have four motor holes on a cardinal pattern at radius 6.0 mm (12.0 mm opposite span), not square-corner coordinates.

motor_hole_layout.comment: Supplied main_frame.stl and prop_guard(x4).stl: hole centres at (Â±6,0),(0,Â±6) relative to each motor. Source files in Actual Mod STL of drone frame.

motor_slot_travel.comment: v3: round D2.3 holes; the 1 mm slot travel is dropped (it costs pad strength; stock STLs have plain holes).

motor_center_hole_d.comment: Supplied main_frame.stl motor-seat centre clearance measures Ã˜8.0 mm.

motor_safe_depth.comment: Measure safe thread depth before energizing. M2x10 has nominal 3 mm engagement; do not use longer unverified screws.

prop_plane_above_bell.comment: Legacy prop center 24.1; verify hub seating with actual motor/prop.

prop_envelope_t.comment: Rotating blade thickness/axial sweep unknown; check full swept envelope physically.

guard_pad_t.comment: Supplied prop_guard(x4).stl motor-seat pad is 3.0 mm thick.

guard_pad_d.comment: Supplied prop_guard(x4).stl motor-seat pad is Ã˜20.0 mm. There are no separate locating pin holes.

guard_od.comment: Supplied prop_guard(x4).stl ring outer diameter is 92.0 mm at the cylindrical band; top chamfer/rib tips are excluded.

guard_wall.comment: rev E: 6 lines (6 x 0.42). The printed rev D ring (1.68 mm) broke when supports were removed. Prop-tip gap = 5.38 mm.

guard_top_z.comment: rev E band 8.0 mm (z 19.1-27.1), symmetric about the assumed prop plane z 23.1 (PLACEHOLDER).

guard_spoke_w.comment: v3: slimmer keel spokes (v2 rev B 3.2); break-test with FitCoupon_GuardSpoke.

guard_spoke_angles_deg.comment: v2 rev B: five independent spokes replace three Y-forks (the printed guards broke at the forks). The end spokes sit 5 deg inside the C ends, so the ring has no long free ends.

guard_keel_deg.comment: v2 rev B: keel faces 50 deg from horizontal: self-supporting when printed pad-down at any spoke slope.

guard_lip.comment: rev E: v2 rev B value restored (outward top lip, hoop stiffness).

guard_collar_h.comment: v2 rev B: collar on the motor side of the guard pad, outside the bell keep-out, deepening the spoke roots. Pad stays 2 mm so motor screw engagement is unchanged.

key_pin_d.comment: Not present in supplied prop_guard(x4).stl interface; set aside until a keyed interface is justified and fit-tested.

key_hole_d.comment: Stock prop_guard has no locating pin holes; no Astra key holes used for stock-compatible guard interface.

key_pin_h.comment: Stock prop_guard has no locating pin interface.

key_offset.comment: Stock prop_guard has no locating pin interface.

arm_lower_sag.comment: v2: 0 = lower chords flat on the bed. Astra 01 sagged 4-6 mm below the pads, leaving the motor-screw seats printed on supports.

body_bolt_half.comment: The square legacy pattern is retained only as the integrated-body leg geometry. Stock bottom-panel mounting uses the separate measured rectangular pattern below.

bottom_mount_points.comment: Supplied main_frame.stl and bottom_panel.stl share four mounting holes at stock coordinates (Â±12,Â±40); rotated into Astra x-forward/y-right axes (+Y stock is forward).

body_bolt_d.comment: M2.5 nominal clearance-hole allowance for Astra's integrated leg hardware; thread and fastener fit are not proven by the supplied STLs.

bottom_frame_hole_d.comment: Supplied main_frame.stl four bottom-panel mounting holes measure Ã˜2.800 mm.

bottom_panel_hole_d.comment: Supplied bottom_panel.stl matching mounting holes measure Ã˜2.750 mm.

fc_hole_spacing.comment: Supplied main_frame.stl FC hole centres have 25.5 mm square side length; pattern is rotated 45Â° relative to the stock XY axes.

fc_hole_rotation_deg.comment: Computed from supplied main_frame.stl FC holes at (Â±18.031,0),(0,Â±18.031), equivalent to a 25.5 mm square rotated 45Â°.

fc_hole_d.comment: Supplied main_frame.stl FC holes measure Ã˜2.300 mm.

fc_size.range: up to 37 x 37 x 15 through deck
fc_size.comment: Legacy 36 x 36 board envelope, 8 mm component height.

usb_size.comment: Side +y cable/tool corridor, verify actual connector side.

plate_size.comment: v3: 4 lines thick (min_wall 1.6). Plate top stays at z -30.

plate_bottom_z.comment: Plate top stays at z -30 as in v2.

strap_w.comment: Actual Velcro unknown; slots sized from width plus 1 mm.

strap_t.comment: Actual compressed strap unknown; 0.6 mm clearance added.

flow_size.comment: MTF-02P 21.6 x 16 x 6.5 mm: micoair.com/?p=4526, rotorvillage.ca and rotorama.com product pages agree. Weight listed as 1.5 g (MicoAir, Rotorama) or 1.8 g (Rotor Village); 1.5 g kept.

flow_hole_spacing.comment: No hole pattern was verifiable (MicoAir lists none; a related MTF-01P listing gives 24.3 x 12.0 mm / D2.5 but it is a different model). The cover therefore grips the board; no screws.

flow_x.comment: Sensor centre x on the plate.

flow_recess.comment: No recess; board top face sits against the plate underside inside the cover.

flow_fov.comment: MicoAir page: optical flow FOV 42 deg; working distance > 8 cm (lidar emit angle 2 deg).

flow_lens_d.comment: Optical aperture diameter: NOT on the product page text. PLACEHOLDER.

elrs_size.comment: Unknown receiver; open pocket, zip ties, rear antenna notch.

camera_size.comment: Combined XIAO, headers/heatsink envelope; local x depth, y width, z height.

camera_mount.comment: v2: 'under_nose' = cheeks rise from the bottom plate's front corners and the camera hangs below the frame, so nothing of the drone is in view at 30-75 deg. 'top' = Astra 01's frame cheeks from the deck corners; then use camera_pivot (38,0,41), where the front guards and props block ~18% of the image at 45 deg.

camera_pivot.comment: Astra x coordinate matches the measured camera-pivot boss axis at stock panel +Y=64.38 mm after the axis rotation. Astra y/z and swept envelope remain design assumptions; the stock camera assembly transform is not present in the STL set.

camera_hfov.comment: v2: from the firmware calibration main/at_detect.c (QVGA 320x240, F_X 163.50, C_X 154.01): edges 43.3/45.4 deg -> conservative symmetric 2 x 45.4 = 90.8 deg.

camera_vfov.comment: v2: from main/at_detect.c (F_Y 153.22, C_Y 107.10): edges 34.9/41.0 deg -> conservative symmetric 2 x 41.0 = 82 deg.

camera_lens_x.comment: Local lens protrusion ahead of board envelope.

camera_hood_margin.comment: v2: TPU hood lip ahead of the lens tip; hood edges sit 64-83 deg off-axis, outside the field of view.

petg_density.comment: g/cm3; use spool density and weigh print.

tpu_density.comment: g/cm3; use spool density and weigh print.

prop_mass.comment: Each, legacy estimate; inertia approximated by disc.

battery_mass.comment: Listing approx +/-5 g, not individually weighed.

misc_mass.comment: Fasteners, standoffs, isolators, wiring, strap, adhesives combined; modeled CG (0,0,0).

arm_w_root.comment: v3 candidate A at criterion X: box width at the diamond ring.

arm_d_root.comment: Depth cap 9 mm (stock envelope). PLACEHOLDER: real limit is FC/battery clearance below the frame, unknown.

arm_tip_stop.comment: Arm box ends this far from the motor centre, inside the D20 pad (r 10), so screw heads under the pad stay free.

boss_od.comment: FC and bottom-hole boss tube OD; height = body depth. Thread/screw engagement unverified.

standoff_top_z.comment: Standoffs run from the plate top (z -30) to the bottom of the body bosses (z -5): 25 mm. Real standoff length UNKNOWN.

foot_x.comment: Feet sit under the four bottom-mount holes (+-40, +-12).

flow_lens_offset.comment: Lens centre relative to the board centre (x,y). Only in the product-page images; PLACEHOLDER = centred. The cone check also reports the worst case for +-3 mm.

flow_lens_offset_range.comment: Worst-case lens position search range, mm.

flow_connector_side.comment: Connector side/pinout only in the page images; the cover has a 10 mm cable notch in the rear (-x) wall as a PLACEHOLDER.

flow_cover_clear.comment: Per-side cavity clearance around the board.

flow_cover_wall.comment: 4 x 0.42 mm lines (min_wall 1.6); 3 lines would be 1.26 mm and violate the 1.6 mm rule.

flow_skirt_h.comment: Skirt below the board bottom (lens plane): lens recessed 2.0 mm behind the skirt. 3.0 mm failed the cone check when the lens is 3 mm off-centre (23.9 deg < 31 deg).

flow_lip.comment: Retaining lip overlap under the board edge (long sides), 45 deg underside.

flow_tab_len.comment: Snap tab length; plate slots are 7.4 x 2.1 mm.

flow_cone_margin_deg.comment: Margin added to the half FOV (21 deg) -> keep out of 31 deg half-angle.

flow_notch.comment: Cable notch width x height in the rear wall.

flow_hook.comment: Snap hook protrusion; 0.7 left only 0.2 mm to the battery bottom, 0.6 leaves 0.4 mm. Engagement over the plate = 0.6 - 0.21 slot clearance.

guard_ring_land.comment: rev E: ring apex is a sharp edge (no flat land): no near-horizontal face anywhere; both faces beside it are 50 deg from horizontal.

guard_ring_bevel_deg.comment: rev E: ring underside face angle from horizontal.

guard_bead_w.comment: rev E inner top bead width (radial); prop-tip gap becomes 4.58 mm

guard_bead_h.comment: rev E inner bead height at the vertical face
